_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The microphone recording is kept when screen selection fails. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". Setting window.__recordingMock.displayError to a message makes screen capture fail with it. Recording uploads (POST /api/upload/raw) answer with the path /tmp/shelley-uploads/kept.webm, and call "uploads" counts them. Message submissions are accepted without being sent on; call "transcription" returns the last one's message and model as JSON ("none" before there is one). The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new and click the voice button. [data-testid="recording-status"] should have the text exactly "Recording…".
2. Eval "window.__recordingMock.displayError = 'Screen sharing was cancelled'".
3. Click [data-testid="recording-screen-button"].
4. [data-testid="recording-error"] should have the text exactly "Screen sharing was cancelled", the recording panel should have data-mode "microphone", and the stop button should be visible.
5. Call "uploads" must return "0".
6. Click the stop button. Call "transcription" should return exactly {"message":"/transcription /tmp/shelley-uploads/kept.webm","model":"predictable"}.
7. The message input should have the value "" (empty), and call "uploads" must return "1".
